jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description: Handle inbound chat and email for a subscription product. Some customers are upset; agents de-escalate within policy.

selection_method.combine_note: Hiring manager reviews the rank and interview impressions and decides overall.

requirements.text: Strong communication skills, because agents resolve escalated customer complaints.
Resolves at least 85% of tier-1 tickets within 24 hours in a paid trial week, because response time drives renewals.
Minimum 5 years of customer support experience.
Typing speed of 60 words per minute.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Build and run Python services for the billing platform. On-call one week in six.

selection_method.combine_note: Fixed weights set before screening: work sample 50%, structured interview 50%.

requirements.text: Strong Python skills, because the billing backend is Python.
Ships and debugs production services, because the team owns uptime.
Has contributed to open-source projects, because it shows code review experience.
Team player with a great culture fit.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description: Inventory and cost reporting for warehouses. Offices in Bengaluru and Chicago.

selection_method.combine_note: Panel discusses test and interview results and reaches a consensus.

requirements.text: Reconciles weekly inventory with under 1% variance in a 2-hour exercise, because stock errors cost margin.
Has used SQL to answer a business question, tested in the work sample, because reports pull from SQL.
